=== Possibly faulty source data ===
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Corellian-Retort-Fly-Casual.png|Corellian Retort & Fly Casual]]: Printed type is Used Interrupt, but the text has USED and LOST sections.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Speak-With-The-Jedi-Council-Vote-Now.png|Speak With The Jedi Council & Vote Now!]]: Printed type is Used Interrupt, but the text has USED and LOST sections.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Effective-Repairs-Punch-It.png|Effective Repairs & Punch It!]]: The image reads "Han or Your Land". This wording remains unchanged for a separate source or rules decision.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Lost-In-The-Wilderness-Yub-Yub.png|Lost In The Wilderness & Yub Yub!]]: The image reads "vehicles of starships". This wording remains unchanged for review.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Rebel-Leadership-Throw-Me-Another-Charge.png|Rebel Leadership & Throw Me Another Charge]]: The image has "Trooper Charge Blasted Droid" without a separator between the two card names.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Were-You-Looking-For-Me-I-Know.png|Were You Looking For Me? & I Know]]: The image reads "react by depoy there". Only depoy was corrected to deploy; the remaining grammar is unchanged.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Jabba-s-Through-With-You-Nevar-Yalnal.png|Jabba's Through With You & Nevar Yalnal]]: The spy-targeting clause checks destiny but contains no instruction to draw it. No instruction was invented.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Surprise-E-Chu-Ta.png|Surprise & E Chu Ta]]: The image reads "no presence of spies". This wording remains unchanged for review.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Podrace-Prep-Too-Close-For-Comfort.png|Podrace Prep & Too Close For Comfort]]: The STARTING clause has a period after the Podracer parenthesis, before Boonta Eve Podrace. Punctuation is preserved.

The earlier Talk sections retain other lore and game-text questions. These are source ambiguities, not missing transcriptions. No GEMP implementation or remastered-image text repair was performed.

== Approved remastered lore wording (28 October 2026) ==
Bill approved the following wording for the remastered edition. These decisions resolve the earlier review questions for these five cards. Original wording remains in the source scans and page history; the approved remastered wording governs future wiki text and image repairs.

* [[:File:RG-GEMP-False-Past.png]]: dreamed possible
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-See-You-At-The-Rendezvous.png]]: Most rebels had their minds set on regrouping with the fleet as soon as possible. Luke had other plans.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Jedi-Rocks.png]]: Playing every night and at whatever other time Jabba wants them to play.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Begin-Retreat.png]]: The rebels knew when the time had come to abandon their posts.
* [[:File:RG-GEMP-Griff-Mirtong.png]]: Bill accepted the existing wording; no change.

False Past and Begin Retreat! restore the original scan wording as confirmed by Bill. See You At The Rendezvous and Jedi Rocks use Bill-approved editorial corrections. The opening "The Max Rebo Band!" remains on Jedi Rocks. Image files still require the corresponding text repairs. --[[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 18:47, 28 October 2026 (UTC)
